note: Evaluator-owned network registry for the network-parametrised holdouts (E12). Owner decision 2026-11-08 (dissent.md 'Resolved 2026-11-08'): the target is Mainnet, the test network is Preview, stagenet is retired. Chain identities are copied by the evaluator from qa/sherlock/target-pins.json (2026-11-07) and sealed here, so an implementer edit of the pins file cannot move a holdout expectation. A null sherlockRun.address means the evaluator has not yet pinned the deployment (after the network's deploy operation and its A4-shape check); cases that need it stay unimplemented.

undeployed.role: local Docker chain at ledger 9.1.0.1 (node :9944, indexer :8088, proof server :6300); rehearsal and local acceptance, never a target qualification
undeployed.genesisNote: each local Docker instance has its own genesis; the receipt records it and it must be 0x + 64 hex

preview.role: public test network (ledger 9.1.0.1, new chain since 2026-11-07); Sherlock M6 qualification target

mainnet.role: production network (real NIGHT/DUST); T4 operations only, each owner-authorized (SWF-009); the holdout only reads
mainnet.indexerTokenNote: Blockfrost project id, appended as ?project_id=; supply it through `vault run`; it is never committed. Absent means host unfit (exit 3).
mainnet.genesisNote: read once from the deprecated rpc.mainnet.midnight.network; re-read through Blockfrost in task 7.2 and resealed if it differs

stagenet.retired: owner decision 2026-11-08: 'not testing on old stagenet'; no stagenet diagnostic call will be made (dissent.md 'Resolved 2026-11-08' item 3; workflow.md section 6). Its cases and lib/stagenet_check.py stay as history and are not selectable.
